To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) WiFi tags can be used for localization; (2) pictures can be used to label WiFi APs; (3) pictures can be automatically labeled from store websites; and (4) pictures can be obtained from a repository, such as Google Street View, or from users.
we can automatically label WiFi APs with store names, using pictures and websites.

1) we can use WiFi-tagged pictures to automatically label stores with their corresponding names, 2) the resulting lookup table can be used to recognize stores, 3) we can achieve high recognition accuracy even with as few pictures as 10, and 4) we can achieve recognition accuracy upwards of $87\%$ with only $10$ pictures per store.
In summary, our research is concerned with
automatic semantic labeling of WiFi-tagged places, and the recognition of these places by users.
